Deliverables are an MIT skeleton repo, a deterministic provider-fixture layer, a spec, CHAINED task sets (tuning + held-out) and hidden acceptance tests. payload.text:
PRODUCT IDEA, as the user described it on 2026-09-14 (source for the spec):
- Users create or chat through agents: save interests and a bucket list; create itineraries for anywhere.
- Flights: automatically shows the best flight price per route, honouring cabin preference. Business-class-only users see only business; economy users see economy.
- Hotels: suggests the best hotels in the area that fit the budget.
- Activities: suggests activities and their costs, e.g. scooter rental and taxi charges.
- To-dos: users can add them; on landing at a location, that location's to-dos show automatically, and new activities there are suggested.
- Auto-curation: e.g. for a 10-day Vietnam itinerary it suggests what could be better and which actions could be improved. Intelligent knowledge: best time to visit, temperature, weather, prices. Geopolitical or flight issues trigger replanning suggestions from the available information.
- Editing: users can tweak the itinerary and add activities; every change refreshes the best flight and route rate.
- Layout: the LEFT pane is the complete itinerary, beautifully organised and formatted. The RIGHT pane is destination info: currency and conversion from the user's home currency, language spoken, nomad-list-style info (cafes that work for working, local specialties and what to try, e.g. coffee), and activities.
- The user also asked that each benchmark item be created one by one.
